body.x: Yamaha participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced ‘Motobot’ and unmanned aerial vehicle produced with the latest technology.

Based on unprecedented research and development, Yamaha’s motorbike riding robot ’Motobot’, which has been produced by combining the latest motorcycle technology with robot technology, can automatically run roads without motorcycle modifications. The technology and knowledge obtained through the development of this Motobot, is expected to create a new value for Yamaha Motors’ existing business and new business development.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
